# MD2PDF — Complete Documentation for AI Agents

> MD2PDF is a free, open-source online tool that converts Markdown (.md) files into beautifully styled PDFs, HTML files, and PNG images. Features include Mermaid diagram rendering, auto table of contents, syntax highlighting for 180+ languages, and end-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM). Conversion runs in the browser with no signup; only share links are stored server-side, encrypted. Includes a public REST API and an installable AI Skill.

Website: https://md2pdf.studio
GitHub: https://github.com/JSiapoDEV/md2pdf
Last updated: 2026-04-16
API version: 1.0 (stable)

---

## Features

- Live split-pane editor with real-time Markdown preview
- GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) support
- Syntax highlighting for 180+ programming languages (via highlight.js)
- **Mermaid diagram rendering** (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, etc.)
- **Auto table of contents** — write `[TOC]` anywhere to generate a linked TOC from headings
- 11 visual styles for document rendering
- Custom CSS injection for full styling control
- Export to PDF (continuous single page), HTML (standalone with inlined styles), and PNG image
- **Encryption** — every shared document is stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM; end-to-end (key never reaches the server) when the client encrypts, as the web app does
- Share documents via encrypted URL; link previews show a generic card because the server cannot read the content
- Dark and light theme toggle
- Drag-and-drop .md file upload
- 5 built-in document templates
- Word count and reading time indicator
- Auto-save drafts to browser localStorage
- Find and replace (Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H)
- Copy button on every code block
- Installable AI Skill in Claude Skills format
- Public REST API for programmatic access
- WebMCP declarative forms for browser-based AI agent integration
- No cookies, no account; conversion never uploads your file, share links are encrypted

## Available Visual Styles

| Style | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| notion | Clean, modern sans-serif (default) |
| github | Classic GitHub markdown rendering |
| minimal | Elegant serif typography, no decorations |
| academic | Formal justified text with a scholarly feel |
| corporate | Professional design with blue accents and styled table headers |
| latex | Simulates academic papers with Libre Baskerville typography |
| dracula | Vibrant purple, pink, and green on dark background |
| newspaper | Editorial typography with Playfair Display headings |
| handwritten | Cursive font with notebook-lined background |
| terminal | Green-on-black monospace, hacker aesthetic |
| pastel | Soft pink, purple, and teal with rounded elements |

## Command line and MCP: `md2pdf-studio` (npm)

The easiest way for an agent to share a document. It encrypts on the machine, uploads only ciphertext and prints the link. Node 18.3+, no dependencies.

```bash
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 share report.md          # or: cat report.md | npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 share
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 update <link|id> report.md
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 delete <link|id>
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 list                     # without keys
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 mcp                      # MCP server over stdio
npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 skill --install          # installs the skill for Claude
```

Options: `--expires 7d` (shorter life, free: 1 hour to 30 days), `--burn` (the link opens a single time; link-preview bots do not use it up), and, with a Pro API key (`--api-key` or `MD2PDF_API_KEY`), `--title` / `--description` for the preview card chat apps show. Those two fields are stored unencrypted. Add `--json` for machine-readable output. Edit and encryption keys are kept in `~/.config/md2pdf-studio/links.json` (current user only), so later sessions can update or delete the link. Always give the user the whole link, including `#k=`.

---

## REST API Reference

No authentication required. Every document is end-to-end encrypted: the caller encrypts with AES-256-GCM and the server stores only ciphertext. Plaintext requests are rejected.

### Trust model

The caller encrypts locally and sends header `X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm`. The server stores the blob as-is; it never sees the key or the plaintext, and so cannot read, search or moderate it. A request without `X-Encrypted` gets 400 `e2ee_required`; a request carrying `X-Enc-Key` gets 400 `key_leak_blocked`.

### Create

Steps: (1) generate a 256-bit key, (2) generate a 12-byte IV, (3) AES-256-GCM encrypt, (4) base64-encode `IV ‖ ciphertext ‖ 16-byte tag`, (5) POST.

```
POST https://md2pdf.studio/api/save
Content-Type: text/plain
X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm

<base64 ciphertext>
```

**Response (JSON):**
```json
{
  "id": "BrOrr0N3",
  "editKey": "a1b2c3d4e5f6...",
  "url": "https://md2pdf.studio/s/BrOrr0N3",
  "expiresAt": "2026-11-05T12:00:00.000Z"
}
```

No `key` field: the server does not have it. Build the shareable link yourself: `{url}#k={your base64url key}`. Store the key only in the caller's process and in the URL you hand to the user.

### Update

Reuse the same key; generate a fresh IV.

```
PUT https://md2pdf.studio/api/update/{id}
Content-Type: text/plain
X-Edit-Key: {editKey}
X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm

<base64 ciphertext>
```

Updating does not extend the link: it expires 30 days after creation. The response includes `expiresAt` (ISO 8601).

### Delete a document

```
DELETE https://md2pdf.studio/api/delete/{id}
X-Edit-Key: {editKey}
```

Response 200: `{ "id": "...", "deleted": true }`. 403 with a wrong edit key, 404 if it no longer exists.

### Example

**Python:**
```python
import os, json, base64, urllib.request
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers.aead import AESGCM

markdown = "# Hello World\n\nThis is a styled document created via the API."

key = AESGCM.generate_key(bit_length=256)
iv  = os.urandom(12)
ct  = AESGCM(key).encrypt(iv, markdown.encode(), None)
body = base64.b64encode(iv + ct).decode()
key_b64url = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(key).rstrip(b"=").decode()

req = urllib.request.Request(
    "https://md2pdf.studio/api/save",
    data=body.encode(),
    headers={"Content-Type": "text/plain", "X-Encrypted": "aes-256-gcm"},
    method="POST",
)
data = json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req).read())
print(f"{data['url']}#k={key_b64url}")
```

### Security

- Documents are encrypted in the client with **AES-256-GCM** before upload. The key is generated by the caller and never leaves the caller's process.
- The `#k=` hash fragment is never sent to the server.
- Cloudflare KV stores only ciphertext.
- The full URL, including `#k=`, is a bearer token. Never paste it in channels that may log or cache URLs.
- Shared pages are served with `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive`.

### Limits

- **Max document size:** 500 KB of Markdown (UTF-8); 5 MB with a Pro API key
- **Rate limit:** 10 writes per minute per IP (save, update and delete combined)
- **Daily quota (free):** 100 writes and 25 MB per address per UTC day (deleting is never limited); a Pro key has a larger quota
- **Link expiration:** 30 days after creation by default (updates do not extend it). `X-Expires-In: <seconds>` (3600 to 2592000) shortens it; a Pro key allows up to 365 days and may extend a link on update
- **One-time links:** `X-Burn: 1` on create. `GET /s/{id}` then serves a page without content, and `POST /api/open/{id}` returns the ciphertext once
- **Preview (Pro):** `Authorization: Bearer <key>` plus `X-Doc-Title` / `X-Doc-Description` (percent-encoded UTF-8, max 100 and 300 bytes). Stored unencrypted; chat apps cannot read the document, so this is the only way to customise the card

### Error Responses

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|--------|---------|------|
| 400 | Empty content | `{"error": "Empty content"}` |
| 400 | No `X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm` header (plaintext is not accepted) | `{"error": "...", "code": "e2ee_required"}` |
| 400 | The body is not base64 ciphertext | `{"error": "...", "code": "not_ciphertext"}` |
| 400 | `X-Enc-Key` sent: the key must never reach the server | `{"error": "...", "code": "key_leak_blocked"}` |
| 413 | Document too large (>500KB) | `{"error": "Document too large (max 500KB)"}` |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded (`Retry-After: 60`) | `{"error": "Too many requests. Try again in a minute."}` |
| 429 | Daily quota reached (`Retry-After` until 00:00 UTC) | `{"error": "...", "code": "daily_quota"}` |
| 403 | The option needs a Pro key (longer than 30 days, custom preview, extending a link) | `{"error": "...", "code": "pro_required"}` |
| 401 | Unknown API key | `{"error": "Unknown API key.", "code": "invalid_api_key"}` |
| 400 | Invalid `X-Expires-In` or preview header | `{"error": "...", "code": "bad_expiry"}` / `"bad_option"` |
| 403 | Invalid edit key on update or delete | `{"error": "Unauthorized"}` |
| 404 | Document not found, expired, or within its last minute | `{"error": "Document not found"}` |

Every API response, including errors, carries `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

## AI Skill (Claude Skills Format)

The skill below can be installed in Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI or any agent that reads instruction files. The full, current version is always at https://md2pdf.studio/skill.md.

```markdown
---
name: md2pdf
description: Create and share styled PDF, HTML, and image documents from Markdown via md2pdf.studio. Use when the user wants to export, share, or create a visually styled document from markdown content.
---

# MD2PDF Skill

Use this skill when the user asks you to export or share Markdown, make a styled document, or get a shareable link.

## Before you share anything

Every link is end-to-end encrypted, but anyone holding the full link can read it. Remove or ask about secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords, customer data) first. Give the user the whole link including `#k=`. Links expire 30 days after creation and can be deleted.

## Share

    npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 share report.md
    cat notes.md | npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 share
    npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 share report.md --expires 7d --burn

## Update or delete (links made on this machine)

    npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 update <link|id> report.md
    npx -y md2pdf-studio@0.1.0 delete <link|id>

## Without npm

Encrypt locally with AES-256-GCM, POST `base64(IV ‖ ciphertext ‖ tag)` to /api/save with `X-Encrypted: aes-256-gcm`, and build the link as {url}#k={base64url key}. Plaintext is rejected; never send the key. See https://md2pdf.studio/skill.md for code.

## Available styles

notion (default), github, minimal, academic, corporate, latex, dracula, newspaper, handwritten, terminal, pastel

## Limits

- Max document size: 500 KB of Markdown (UTF-8)
- Rate limit: 10 writes/min per IP, 100 writes/day (free)
- Expiration: 30 days after creation (updates do not extend it); --expires shortens it; --burn makes a link one-time
- No authentication required
```

## Document Templates

Pre-built templates available in the editor:

1. **CV / Resume** — Professional resume layout
2. **Report** — Monthly or project report
3. **Documentation** — Technical project documentation
4. **Changelog** — Software release changelog
5. **Meeting Notes** — Structured meeting notes

---

## Supported Markdown Syntax

MD2PDF supports full GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) plus extensions:

- Headings (H1–H6) with auto-generated anchor IDs
- Paragraphs with line breaks
- **Bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~
- Ordered and unordered lists
- Task lists (checkboxes)
- Code blocks with language-specific syntax highlighting (180+ languages)
- Inline code
- Tables with alignment
- Blockquotes
- Images (inline and reference)
- Horizontal rules
- Links (inline and reference)
- **Mermaid diagrams** — use ` ```mermaid ` code blocks for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, and more
- **Auto table of contents** — write `[TOC]` on its own line to generate a linked table of contents from all headings

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| Ctrl+S / Cmd+S | Export to PDF |
| Ctrl+F / Cmd+F | Find in editor |
| Ctrl+H / Cmd+H | Find and replace |
| Ctrl+Shift+L / Cmd+Shift+L | Toggle dark/light theme |
| Tab | Insert tab in editor |

---

## Technical Details

- Pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no framework, no build step
- marked.js (v12.0.1) for Markdown parsing
- highlight.js (v11.9.0) for syntax highlighting (180+ languages)
- html2canvas (v1.4.1) for image export
- GitHub Markdown CSS (v5.5.1) as base styling
- Hosted on Cloudflare Workers + KV for shared documents
- Browser native print dialog for PDF export
